cards.example_en: She plays the piano after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭后她弹钢琴。

cards.example_en: She helped me pick a clean shirt for the school photo.
cards.example_zh: 她帮我为学校拍照挑了一件干净衬衫。

cards.example_en: We had a picnic by the lake.
cards.example_zh: 我们在湖边野餐。

cards.example_en: A picture of the harbour hangs above our sofa.
cards.example_zh: 我们沙发上方挂着一张海港的图片。

cards.example_en: The apple pie smelled wonderful.
cards.example_zh: 苹果派闻起来很香。

cards.example_en: She gave me a piece of cake after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭后，她给了我一块蛋糕。

cards.example_en: The pig slept in the shade beside the barn.
cards.example_zh: 猪睡在谷仓旁边的阴凉处。

cards.example_en: Take this pill after breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 早饭后吃这颗药。

cards.example_en: The pilot checked the weather before take-off.
cards.example_zh: 飞行员在起飞前查看了天气。

cards.example_en: They play ping-pong in the gym.
cards.example_zh: 他们在体育馆打乒乓球。

cards.example_en: She tied a pink ribbon around the birthday gift.
cards.example_zh: 她在生日礼物上系了一条粉红色丝带。

cards.example_en: She was a pioneer of the school radio club.
cards.example_zh: 她是学校广播社的开创者。

cards.example_en: It is a pity that you missed the show.
cards.example_zh: 你错过演出真可惜。

cards.example_en: We shared a pizza after the match.
cards.example_zh: 比赛后我们分着吃了一块披萨。

cards.example_en: This place is quiet enough for evening homework.
cards.example_zh: 这个地方很安静，适合晚上写作业。

cards.example_en: Our plan is to visit the zoo on Sunday.
cards.example_zh: 我们的计划是星期天去动物园。

cards.example_en: We missed the bus home because the plane was late.
cards.example_zh: 因为飞机晚点，我们没赶上回家的公交。

cards.example_en: Mars is the red planet shown in our science book.
cards.example_zh: 火星是我们科学书里那颗红色的行星。

cards.example_en: The plant by the window needs water twice a week.
cards.example_zh: 窗边那株植物一周要浇两次水。

cards.example_en: Do not put plastic bags into the hot oven.
cards.example_zh: 不要把塑料袋放进热烤箱里。

cards.example_en: He dropped his plate and soup spilled on the floor.
cards.example_zh: 他的盘子掉了，汤洒在地板上。

cards.example_en: They play basketball on the outdoor court after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 他们午饭后在室外球场打篮球。

cards.example_en: Children were running on the playground.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们在操场上跑。

cards.example_en: Please open your books to page ten.
cards.example_zh: 请把书翻到第十页。

cards.example_en: It's a pleasure to meet you.
cards.example_zh: 很高兴认识你。

cards.example_en: There is plenty of time before the test.
cards.example_zh: 考试前还有充足的时间。

cards.example_en: The meeting starts at 3 p.m.
cards.example_zh: 会议下午三点开始。

cards.example_en: A bus ticket was still in my coat pocket.
cards.example_zh: 我外套口袋里还剩着一张公交票。

cards.example_en: She wrote a short poem about the autumn moon.
cards.example_zh: 她以秋月为题写了一首诗作。

cards.example_en: The poet read a short poem aloud.
cards.example_zh: 诗人大声读了一首短诗。

cards.example_en: She explained her point with a simple example.
cards.example_zh: 她用一个简单的例子说明了自己的论点。

cards.example_en: The police directed traffic outside the stadium.
cards.example_zh: 警方在体育场外指挥交通。

cards.example_en: A policeman helped the child cross the road.
cards.example_zh: 一位警察帮孩子过马路。

cards.example_en: The policewoman asked for his name.
cards.example_zh: 女警察询问他的名字。

cards.example_en: It is polite to say thank you.
cards.example_zh: 说谢谢是有礼貌的。

cards.example_en: Smoke from cars can pollute the air.
cards.example_zh: 汽车尾气会污染空气。

cards.example_en: The sports hall pool closed after the heavy rain.
cards.example_zh: 大雨之后，体育馆的水池关闭了。

cards.example_en: The poor family received food from the neighbours.
cards.example_zh: 那户贫穷的家庭收到了邻居送来的食物。

cards.example_en: Football is popular among students at our school.
cards.example_zh: 足球在我们学校的学生当中很受欢迎。

cards.example_en: Our town's population grew after the new factory opened.
cards.example_zh: 新工厂开业后，我们镇的人口增加了。

cards.example_en: We had pork for dinner.
cards.example_zh: 我们晚饭吃了猪肉。

cards.example_en: I had porridge for breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 我早餐喝了粥。

cards.example_en: His position is that school exams should be shorter.
cards.example_zh: 他的立场是学校考试应该缩短。

cards.example_en: His positive reply meant we could use the hall.
cards.example_zh: 他肯定的答复意味着我们可以使用礼堂。

cards.example_en: Is it possible to finish the poster before lunch?
cards.example_zh: 午饭前把海报做完，有可能吗？

cards.example_en: Students post club notices on the board by the stairs.
cards.example_zh: 学生们把社团通知张贴在楼梯旁的布告栏上。

cards.example_en: Send me a postcard from Spain!
cards.example_zh: 从西班牙给我寄张明信片！

cards.example_en: The postman left a letter at the door.
cards.example_zh: 邮递员在门口留下一封信。

cards.example_en: Soup boiled over in the pot on the stove.
cards.example_zh: 炉子上的锅里，汤沸得溢了出来。

cards.example_en: She mashed a hot potato with butter for dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭时，她把一个热马铃薯加黄油捣成了泥。

word.example_en: Please pick up the paper on the floor.
Can you pick out the topic sentence?
They have a picnic under the trees.
The meeting will take place in Room 3.
word.example_zh: 会议将在 3 号房间举行。

word.example_en: Tea was served in place of coffee.
Let us make a plan for the trip.
word.example_zh: 我们来为旅行制定计划。

word.example_en: Clubs play a part in school life.
word.example_zh: 社团在校园生活中起一份作用。

word.example_en: Sleep can play a role in memory.
word.example_zh: 睡眠可以在记忆中起作用。

word.example_en: Can you point out the error?
She was on the point of leaving.
We should be polite to guests.
word.example_zh: 我们应当对客人有礼貌。

word.example_en: The club is popular with Grade 8.
word.example_zh: 这个社团受八年级欢迎。
